import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
export const SENTINEL = "crpko-acl-probe-absent";
export const digest = (value) =>
  createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(value)).digest("hex");
export const probeClass = (p) =>
  p === "topic_provisioner"
    ? "P"
    : p === "clickhouse_balance_bootstrap"
      ? "N"
      : p === "harness-qa-reader-v1"
        ? "H"
        : [
              "kafka-history-archiver-v1",
              "backoffice_registry_recovery",
            ].includes(p)
          ? "T"
          : [
                "reporting-api-v1",
                "kafbat-v1",
                "telemetry",
                "venue-router-release-observer",
              ].includes(p)
            ? "D"
            : "S";
const fail = (message) => {
  throw new Error(message);
};
const matches = (r, name) =>
  r.pattern_type === "PREFIXED"
    ? name.startsWith(r.resource_name)
    : name === r.resource_name;
export function deriveProbeMatrix(manifest) {
  const names = [
    ...new Set(manifest.rows.map((r) => r.principal.replace(/^User:/, ""))),
  ].sort();
  if (
    !names.length ||
    names.some((p) => !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(p) || p.startsWith("broker"))
  )
    fail("invalid probe principals");
  if (
    manifest.rows.some(
      (r) => r.resource_name === SENTINEL || r.permission_type !== "ALLOW",
    )
  )
    fail("sentinel row or unsupported ACL permission");
  return {
    schema: "crpko.kafka.acl-probe-matrix.v1",
    environment: manifest.environment,
    manifest_sha256: manifest.sha256,
    principals: names.map((principal) => ({
      principal,
      class: probeClass(principal),
      port: probeClass(principal) === "T" ? 9097 : 9096,
      secret_name: `crpko/${manifest.environment}/kafka/scram/${principal}`,
      row_count: manifest.rows.filter(
        (r) => r.principal === `User:${principal}`,
      ).length,
      rows_sha256: digest(
        manifest.rows.filter((r) => r.principal === `User:${principal}`),
      ),
    })),
  };
}
export function planPrincipal(
  manifest,
  principal,
  { stage = "post-topic", run = "dry-run" } = {},
) {
  if (
    !["pre-topic", "post-topic"].includes(stage) ||
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$/.test(run)
  )
    fail("invalid probe stage or run");
  const entry = deriveProbeMatrix(manifest).principals.find(
    (p) => p.principal === principal,
  );
  if (!entry || (stage === "pre-topic" && entry.class !== "P"))
    fail("principal not admitted at this stage");
  const rows = manifest.rows.filter((r) => r.principal === `User:${principal}`),
    cls = entry.class;
  const has = (type, name, op) =>
    rows.some(
      (r) =>
        r.resource_type === type &&
        matches(r, name) &&
        (r.operation === op ||
          (op === "DESCRIBE" &&
            ["READ", "WRITE", "DELETE", "ALTER"].includes(r.operation))),
    );
  const allTopics = [
    ...new Set(
      manifest.rows
        .filter((r) => r.resource_type === "TOPIC")
        .map((r) => r.resource_name),
    ),
  ].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      Number(a.startsWith("__")) - Number(b.startsWith("__")) ||
      a.localeCompare(b),
  );
  const allGroups = [
    ...new Set(
      manifest.rows
        .filter(
          (r) => r.resource_type === "GROUP" && r.pattern_type === "LITERAL",
        )
        .map((r) => r.resource_name),
    ),
  ].sort();
  const probes = [],
    inventory = rows.map((r) => ({
      row_id: r.row_id,
      resource_type: r.resource_type,
      resource: r.resource_name,
      operation: r.operation,
      proof: "G-ACL exact row readback",
    }));
  const add = (api, resource = "", expected = "NONE", extra = {}) =>
    probes.push({ api, resource, expected, ...extra });
  const foreign = (type, op, list) => list.find((n) => !has(type, n, op));
  const positiveTopics = (op) =>
    [
      ...new Set(
        rows
          .filter((r) => r.resource_type === "TOPIC" && r.operation === op)
          .map((r) => r.resource_name),
      ),
    ].sort();
  const topicDenied = "TOPIC_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED",
    groupDenied = "GROUP_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED";
  if (cls === "P" && stage === "pre-topic") {
    add("DescribeCluster");
    add("Metadata");
    add("CreateTopics", positiveTopics("DESCRIBE")[0], "NONE", {
      validateOnly: true,
    });
    add("DescribeAcls");
    add("Fetch", SENTINEL, topicDenied, {
      partition: 0,
      offset: "0",
      requiresTopic: false,
    });
    add("DeleteTopics", SENTINEL, topicDenied);
    add("DeleteRecords", SENTINEL, topicDenied, { partition: 0, offset: "0" });
  } else {
    if (cls !== "H") add("Authenticate");
    for (const topic of positiveTopics("DESCRIBE"))
      if (cls !== "H") add("Metadata", topic);
    for (const topic of positiveTopics("READ")) {
      if (cls !== "N")
        add("Fetch", topic, "NONE", { assignment: true, offset: "latest" });
      add("ListOffsets", topic, "NONE", { time: "latest" });
    }
    if (cls !== "H") {
      for (const r of rows
        .filter(
          (r) =>
            r.resource_type === "GROUP" &&
            ["DESCRIBE", "READ"].includes(r.operation) &&
            r.pattern_type === "LITERAL",
        )
        .filter(
          (r, i, a) =>
            a.findIndex((x) => x.resource_name === r.resource_name) === i,
        )) {
        add("DescribeGroups", r.resource_name);
        add("OffsetFetch", r.resource_name);
      }
      for (const r of rows.filter(
        (r) =>
          r.resource_type === "GROUP" &&
          r.operation === "READ" &&
          r.pattern_type === "PREFIXED",
      ))
        add("ProbeGroup", `${r.resource_name}acl-probe-${run}`);
      if (
        rows.some((r) => r.resource_type === "TOPIC" && r.operation === "WRITE")
      )
        add("InitProducerId");
      for (const r of rows.filter(
        (r) =>
          r.resource_type === "TRANSACTIONAL_ID" && r.operation === "WRITE",
      ))
        add(
          "InitProducerId",
          r.pattern_type === "PREFIXED"
            ? `${r.resource_name}acl-probe-${run}`
            : r.resource_name,
        );
      for (const topic of positiveTopics("DESCRIBE_CONFIGS"))
        add("DescribeConfigs", topic, "NONE", {
          compacted: principal === "kafka-history-archiver-v1",
          ...(principal === "kafka-history-archiver-v1"
            ? {
                required_configs: {
                  "cleanup.policy": "compact",
                },
                minimum_configs: {
                  "min.compaction.lag.ms": "604800000",
                },
              }
            : {}),
        });
    }
    const noRead = foreign("TOPIC", "READ", allTopics),
      noDescribe = foreign("TOPIC", "DESCRIBE", allTopics),
      noGroup = foreign("GROUP", "DESCRIBE", allGroups);
    if (!noRead) fail(`${principal}: no foreign topic for Fetch/ListOffsets`);
    add("Fetch", noRead, topicDenied, {
      partition: 0,
      offset: "latest",
      assignment: true,
    });
    if (noDescribe)
      add("ListOffsets", noDescribe, topicDenied, {
        partition: 0,
        time: "latest",
      });
    if (cls !== "H") {
      if (noDescribe) add("Metadata", noDescribe, topicDenied);
      if (noGroup) {
        add("OffsetFetch", noGroup, groupDenied);
        add("DescribeGroups", noGroup, groupDenied);
      }
      const tx = `crpko-acl-probe-foreign-${run}`;
      if (has("TRANSACTIONAL_ID", tx, "WRITE"))
        fail("foreign transaction overlaps grant");
      add("InitProducerId", tx, "TRANSACTIONAL_ID_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED");
      const alter = foreign("TOPIC", "ALTER_CONFIGS", allTopics);
      if (cls !== "P" && alter)
        add("IncrementalAlterConfigs", alter, topicDenied, {
          validateOnly: true,
          key: "retention.ms",
          value: "604800000",
        });
      if (cls !== "P") {
        const noConfigs = foreign("TOPIC", "DESCRIBE_CONFIGS", allTopics);
        if (noConfigs) add("DescribeConfigs", noConfigs, topicDenied);
      }
      if (
        !rows.some(
          (r) => r.resource_type === "TOPIC" && r.operation === "WRITE",
        ) &&
        !has("CLUSTER", "kafka-cluster", "IDEMPOTENT_WRITE")
      )
        add("InitProducerId", "", "CLUSTER_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED");
      if (cls !== "P") {
        for (const topic of positiveTopics("DESCRIBE_CONFIGS"))
          if (
            !has("TOPIC", topic, "ALTER_CONFIGS") &&
            !has("CLUSTER", "kafka-cluster", "ALTER_CONFIGS")
          )
            for (const api of ["AlterConfigs", "IncrementalAlterConfigs"])
              add(api, topic, topicDenied, {
                validateOnly: true,
                key: "retention.ms",
                value: "604800000",
              });
      }
      add("Produce", SENTINEL, topicDenied);
      add("DeleteTopics", SENTINEL, topicDenied);
      add("DeleteRecords", SENTINEL, topicDenied, {
        partition: 0,
        offset: "0",
      });
      add(
        "DescribeAcls",
        "",
        has("CLUSTER", "kafka-cluster", "DESCRIBE")
          ? "NONE"
          : "CLUSTER_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED",
      );
    }
    if (cls !== "P")
      add("CreateTopics", SENTINEL, topicDenied, { validateOnly: true });
    else {
      const topic = positiveTopics("ALTER_CONFIGS")[0];
      add("IncrementalAlterConfigs", topic, "NONE", {
        validateOnly: true,
        key: "retention.ms",
        value: "604800000",
      });
    }
    if (cls === "N") {
      // Keep N's set independent of the service templates.
      probes.length = 0;
      const ingestion = JSON.parse(
        readFileSync(
          new URL(
            "../../plan/kafka/topic-manifests/clickhouse-ingestor.v1.json",
            import.meta.url,
          ),
        ),
      );
      const priority = [
        ingestion.modes["canonical-priority"].consumer_groups
          .flatMap((g) => g.topics)
          .find((t) => !t.includes("balance.updated")),
        ingestion.modes["canonical-bulk"].consumer_groups.flatMap(
          (g) => g.topics,
        )[0],
      ];
      const cash = "evt.ledger.cash_balance.updated.v1",
        projector = `clickhouse-balance-projector-v2-${manifest.environment}`;
      for (const topic of priority) {
        add("Metadata", topic);
        add("ListOffsets", topic, "NONE", { time: "earliest" });
        add("ListOffsets", topic, "NONE", { time: "latest" });
      }
      const laneGroups = [
        ingestion.modes["canonical-priority"].consumer_groups.find((g) =>
          g.topics.includes(cash),
        ).group,
      ];
      for (const group of laneGroups) {
        add("DescribeGroups", group);
        add("OffsetFetch", group);
      }
      add("ProjectorFloor", projector, "NONE", {
        topic: cash,
        emptyAndMemberless: true,
      });
      add("InitProducerId", "", "CLUSTER_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED");
      add("Produce", SENTINEL, topicDenied);
      add("Fetch", priority[0], topicDenied, {
        partition: 0,
        offset: "latest",
        assignment: true,
      });
      for (const group of [laneGroups[0], "reporting-commands"])
        add("FencedOffsetCommit", group, groupDenied, {
          topic: cash,
          partition: 0,
          generation: 2147483647,
          member: `crpko-acl-probe-${run}`,
        });
      add("OffsetFetch", "reporting-commands", groupDenied);
      add("DescribeGroups", "reporting-commands", groupDenied);
      add("CreateTopics", SENTINEL, topicDenied, { validateOnly: true });
      add("DeleteRecords", cash, topicDenied, { partition: 0, offset: "0" });
      add("DescribeAcls", "", "CLUSTER_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED");
    }
    if (cls === "T")
      for (const [transport, expected] of Object.entries({
        port9096: "UNREACHABLE",
        noSasl: "NO_KAFKA_RESPONSE",
        plaintext: "TLS_RECORD_REFUSED",
        saslPlaintext: "TLS_RECORD_REFUSED",
        wrongCA: "CERTIFICATE_REFUSED",
        wrongName: "HOSTNAME_REFUSED",
        wrongPassword: "SASL_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED",
      }))
        add("Transport", transport, expected);
  }
  const plan = {
    ...entry,
    stage,
    run,
    probes,
    inventory,
    inventory_denials: [
      "foreign WRITE",
      "foreign GROUP READ",
      "CLUSTER ALTER",
      "DELETE",
      "ALTER",
    ],
  };
  assertSafePlan(plan);
  return plan;
}
export function assertSafePlan(plan) {
  for (const p of plan.probes) {
    if (
      [
        "CreateAcls",
        "DeleteAcls",
        "OffsetCommit",
        "JoinGroup",
        "SyncGroup",
      ].includes(p.api)
    )
      fail("unsafe direct mutation");
    if (p.api === "Produce" && p.resource !== SENTINEL) fail("unsafe produce");
    if (
      ["CreateTopics", "AlterConfigs", "IncrementalAlterConfigs"].includes(
        p.api,
      ) &&
      p.validateOnly !== true
    )
      fail("unsafe configuration mutation");
    if (p.api === "ProbeGroup" && !p.resource.includes("acl-probe-"))
      fail("unsafe group join");
    if (
      p.api.startsWith("Delete") &&
      p.resource !== SENTINEL &&
      !(
        plan.class === "N" &&
        p.api === "DeleteRecords" &&
        p.resource === "evt.ledger.cash_balance.updated.v1" &&
        p.offset === "0"
      )
    )
      fail("unsafe delete");
    if (
      p.api === "ProjectorFloor" &&
      !(plan.class === "N" && p.emptyAndMemberless === true)
    )
      fail("unsafe commit");
    if (
      p.api === "FencedOffsetCommit" &&
      !(
        plan.class === "N" &&
        p.generation === 2147483647 &&
        p.member.startsWith("crpko-acl-probe-")
      )
    )
      fail("unfenced commit");
  }
  return plan;
}
export function assertEmpty(topology, topics) {
  if (!topics.length || new Set(topics).size !== topics.length)
    fail("empty range inventory unavailable");
  for (const topic of topics) {
    const parts = topology[topic];
    if (
      !Array.isArray(parts) ||
      !parts.length ||
      parts.some(
        (p, i) =>
          p.partition !== i || !/^\d+$/.test(p.start) || p.start !== p.end,
      )
    )
      fail(`G-EMPTY failed: ${topic}`);
  }
}
export const BINDINGS = [
  "installation_id",
  "environment",
  "account_id",
  "region",
  "cluster_id",
  "format_sha256",
  "manifest_sha256",
  "listing_sha256",
  "user_list_sha256",
];
export function requireBinding(receipt, current) {
  if (
    !receipt ||
    BINDINGS.some(
      (k) =>
        typeof current[k] !== "string" ||
        !current[k] ||
        receipt[k] !== current[k],
    )
  )
    fail("probe evidence binding changed");
}
export function requirePreflight(receipts, current, principals) {
  if (
    !Array.isArray(receipts) ||
    receipts.length !== principals.length ||
    new Set(receipts.map((r) => r.principal)).size !== principals.length
  )
    fail("every principal needs preflight");
  for (const p of principals) {
    const r = receipts.find((r) => r.principal === p);
    requireBinding(r, current);
    if (r.preflight !== true || r.username !== p || r.passed !== true)
      fail("preflight failed");
  }
}
export function classifyResult(probe, result) {
  if (
    !result ||
    result.outcome !== probe.expected ||
    result.kind !== (probe.api === "Transport" ? "transport" : "kafka") ||
    result.client_error
  )
    fail(
      `${probe.api} expected ${probe.expected}, received ${result?.outcome ?? "missing"}`,
    );
  return true;
}
export function validateProbeReceipt(
  receipt,
  manifest,
  principal,
  { stage, run },
) {
  const plan = planPrincipal(manifest, principal, { stage, run });
  if (
    receipt?.principal !== principal ||
    receipt.passed !== true ||
    receipt.preflight !== false ||
    receipt.stage !== stage ||
    receipt.class !== plan.class ||
    receipt.plan_sha256 !== digest(plan) ||
    receipt.matrix_sha256 !== digest(deriveProbeMatrix(manifest)) ||
    receipt.probe_count !== plan.probes.length ||
    !Array.isArray(receipt.results) ||
    receipt.results.length !== plan.probes.length
  )
    fail("probe receipt does not match the complete current plan");
  for (let i = 0; i < plan.probes.length; i++) {
    const probe = plan.probes[i],
      actual = receipt.results[i];
    if (actual?.api !== probe.api || actual.resource !== probe.resource)
      fail("probe receipt operation differs");
    classifyResult(probe, actual);
  }
  return receipt;
}
